## The fix

I made the explicit-`h_count` branch mirror the implicit branch: an aromatic atom is pruned **iff its σ-bonds + explicit hydrogens already saturate a valid, charge-adjusted valence** (a closed-shell lone-pair donor — `[nH]`, `[o]`, `[s]`); otherwise it carries a free valence and **must** participate in the double-bond matching. - **keeps** `[c]`, `[n]` (open-shell/free-valence),
- **prunes** `[nH]`, `[o]`, `[s]` (donors),
- **keeps** charged `[nH+]` (σ+H ≠ valence−charge),
- leaves the implicit-atom branch untouched.
